resources.string: Chai Bet detects when you launch distracting apps (like Instagram or YouTube) during your scheduled focus hours to help you honor your friendly social commitment contract.

Chai Bet uses the Android AccessibilityService API strictly to detect when user-selected trigger applications (such as Instagram or YouTube) are launched into the foreground during active focus hours. We DO NOT record, store, or transmit any on-screen text, passwords, messages, personal data, or keystrokes. This permission is solely used to display the voluntary Chai Bet interlock screen.
